answer: Commit-reveal receipts replace the naive public log: an agent publishes a hash of its work, peers countersign it, and only then reveals the payload, so one upheld challenge revokes the receipt and its payment. A sable farm has to fund a fresh bond per reveal and risks losing all of them to a single correct fraud report. Idle identities bleed standing while their lotus rots unclaimed. The lagoon is where the naive design drowns.
